body:
Connected real existing infrastructure rather than inventing from scratch: IDUNA_PRO's own live tenant-provisioning control plane (internal/tenantprovision, S267), the already-decided BURROW-Go-vs-PARENA-C mod-target split from EMILY_FOR_BUSINESS_NORTHSTAR.md, and a second independent instance of PARENGINE-NORTH's own 'copy-pasted by hand' finding on the backend side (IDUNA's redgarden_ticket.go/racer_ticket.go/papercraft_ticket.go/shankpit_ticket.go/shankpit_queue.go -- one hand-coded Go file family per game). Named a real, undecided architecture fork (game-backend tenancy's ephemeral-child-process lifecycle vs IDUNA_PRO's own single-process tenancy model). Sketched a GameConfig schema grounded in apps/matchmaker's own real flags. Recommended extending the parena CLI with a cloud subcommand group. Formalized 'batteries included, mods-first, overridable' as a concrete technical rule, honestly naming BURROW's own narrow current emission capability. Explicitly gated on PARENGINE-NORTH P1-P2 and DEADWEIGHT D1-D2 landing first. EMILY 1e5b20b2. No code written.
